remarks: Enjoy the peace and privacy of this beautiful 2.1-acre property in Allegany. Overlooking a picturesque spring-fed pond, the property offers scenic views across the southern portion of the land and a tranquil setting to relax and enjoy nature. Existing improvements include a well, electric service, and a 1,000-gallon septic system on site, that where used for a two bedroom Mobil home ( no longer on site), providing a great foundation for future use. A spacious covered porch/deck area, multiple storage sheds, and a lean-to add convenience and functionality. Whether you're looking for a seasonal getaway, recreational property, or future building site, this property offers plenty of potential. Located in the Allegany-Limestone School District, Conveniently situated just minutes from downtown Allegany, Ellicottville, Cuba, and within easy driving distance of Jamestown and Buffalo.
